load_when: When running recursive generation/testing loops or orchestrating sub-agents.

structured_escape_routing.on_max_iterations: Stop loop, record state in pending_sync.json and report to Architect.
structured_escape_routing.on_no_progress: If two consecutive iterations do not change state → immediate escape.

forbidden: Recursive code generation over main working tree without isolation

isolation.principle: Recursive generation or testing loops run in isolated git worktrees or virtual sandboxes to avoid polluting the working tree.
isolation.cleanup: Remove worktree/sandbox on completion if no accepted changes produced.
